tests.name: Unauthenticated call is challenged with discovery metadata
tests.why: Claude Code finds the sign-in page only through the 401 + resource metadata

tests.name: Officer endpoint without a scope still gets the officer sign-in
tests.why: if a client omits scope, the portal infers it from the resource instead of defaulting to citizen OTP

tests.name: Citizen sees no officer tools, and tokens do not cross endpoints
tests.why: Brief: a citizen's assistant should not even see the officer's tools
tests.detail: 7 citizen tools; citizen->officer 401; officer->citizen rejected; wrong audience rejected

tests.name: Ending a sign-in stops the assistant immediately
tests.why: shared phones and kiosks: 'end this sign-in' must not leave a 20-minute window
tests.detail: access token refused right after revocation

tests.name: Kamala applies end to end; visible on the portal like a web application
tests.why: the core job: a real application, same rules, same records, both places

tests.name: Retried and concurrent submits create exactly one application
tests.why: small models retry tool calls; the database now enforces one active application per mobile
tests.detail: 1 row after 1+1 sequential and 6 parallel submits

tests.name: Under-60 applicant is refused with the date she becomes eligible
tests.why: never get anyone a pension the counter would not
tests.detail: 25 Oct 2026 (before the window closes on 31 Oct 2026)

tests.name: Unknown date of birth is never guessed
tests.why: elderly applicants often know only their age; the assistant must ask for the document
tests.detail: date of birth not saved: an exact date of birth is needed, as written on her age proof (birth certificate, school certificate or Voter ID); an age or year is not enough

tests.name: Old United Bank IFSC is blocked with a useful hint
tests.why: 16,576 seeded records carry UTBI0PUR2819, which the portal's own validator rejects
tests.detail: IFSC refused, merger hint given, block inferred from village

tests.name: Second person on a shared phone cannot use the same mobile
tests.why: couples share one phone; one active application per mobile is the portal's rule

tests.name: Withdraw needs the number twice; then she can apply afresh
tests.why: irreversible actions need explicit confirmation; withdrawal works like the status portal

tests.name: A citizen cannot touch someone else's application
tests.why: identity comes from the OTP-verified token, never from tool arguments

tests.name: Upload link rejects fake files and expired links
tests.why: the age proof is the main evidence; uploads are validated by content, not by name

tests.name: Block officer sees only her block and decides against her own name
tests.why: Director: she sees what is waiting for her and decides for a reason recorded against her name
tests.detail: SSP26179944 approved by Rina Gogoi; Khelua officer could not see it

tests.name: Approval of an under-60 applicant is refused on every channel
tests.why: historic data has 2,585 approvals of people under 60 when they applied; the rule now holds
tests.detail: flagged on review; approval refused; rejection with UNDER_AGE recorded

tests.name: Duplicate beneficiary is flagged for the officer
tests.why: 398 people hold two pensions under different mobiles; officers already reject 'duplicate of an earlier beneficiary'
tests.detail: flagged; approval without a note refused; rejected as duplicate

tests.name: Instructions hidden in an applicant's name are treated as data
tests.why: officers' assistants read applicant text; it must not steer them
tests.detail: text isolated under applicant_entered; nothing decided by the tool

tests.name: Program tokens can read but not decide, and can be revoked
tests.why: an unattended program must never approve a pension; README admits revocation was missing
tests.detail: read ok; decide refused; 401 after revocation
